scope: Road-prior branch first; current M2 vehicle asset frozen; no road repair, prior training or shutdown in this assessment

diagnosis.reported_user_570_roi: Coordinates unavailable; not reproduced as exact570
diagnosis.cause: Finite constructed road world-domain/envelope excludes footprint; not old-layer occlusion or runtime active masking
diagnosis.limits: Source-valid RGB and stable upper cluster are evidence/proxies, not independent clean albedo ground truth; unknown geometry or absent qualified source does not establish never visible

evidence_states: Actual road geometry and RGB observed: recover measurements
Actual road geometry only: preserve geometry, infer missing material separately
Candidate surface with partial RGB/uncertain height: retain uncertainty and seek more views
All declared camera opportunities actually blocked at candidate height interval: prior-only within declared inputs
Out of view, invalid calibration or missing source: unknown, not observed-empty and not proven always-occluded

representation.geometry: One persistent world-coordinate local2.5D road surface h(u), thin mesh/surfel, observed LiDAR anchors; first scope excludes stacked bridge/underpass topology
representation.material: Road base colour/texture plus lane/marking structure in the same world/material coordinates; exposure and shadow uncertainty reported separately
representation.MOG2_mapping: c=[c_h,c_m]=mu(q)+U(q)z; visible and hidden share the same structural modes. q comes only from legal context; fit scene z with actual measurements. No independent hidden free residual
representation.prior_role: Frozen pretrained model proposes candidates; real road observations constrain local3D fitting; predictions retain provenance and uncertainty
representation.IO_contract: Separate geometry and material outputs: image inpainting emits RGB, not road height; meshgrid reconstruction is not itself a pretrained hidden-road generator. Record each model's real input/output, units, missing channels and downstream Gaussianization separately, as learned from the vehicle PVD I/O audit
representation.rendering: First use current single joint Gaussian raster with bounded thin support and independent analytic surface reference. Full opaque first-hit MOG2 renderer remains a separate implementation claim
representation.legacy_takeover: Register conflicting/duplicated old road primitives; persistent coefficients across time,camera,edit; re-express mixed protected surfaces before retirement
representation.environment: Background remains frozen; verified road rays must hit road opacity/surface rather than receive sky-direction background; disabling environment alone is not road reconstruction
